findings.claim: `@default os.availableParallelism()` documents a Node API unavailable on older Node versions and may not reflect the real fallback
findings.rationale: `os.availableParallelism()` exists only in Node 18.14/19.4+. If the implementation actually uses something like `os.availableParallelism?.() ?? os.cpus().length`, or clamps the value, this documented default is inaccurate. Worth confirming the runtime default matches and that the call is guarded for the minimum supported Node version. Doc-only here, so no direct behavioral impact; moderate confidence this is a doc imprecision.
